name: menu without the administration
eval: document.querySelector('button[title=Menu]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const txt=document.body.innerText; const ok=txt.includes('Génération') && !txt.includes('Modèles') && !/\nService\n/.test(txt); window.__menu=txt.slice(0,200); return ok

name: settings without the two tabs
eval: const item=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,.item,[role=menuitem]')].find(b=>(b.innerText||'').trim()==='Général'); item.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog .tabs button')].map(b=>b.dataset.tab); window.__tabs=tabs; return tabs.length===5 && !tabs.includes('modelsTab') && !tabs.includes('serviceTab')

name: ask through the gateway
eval: const a=document.querySelector('.composer .md-field'); a.value='Quelle est la capitale du Japon ? Un mot.'; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); document.querySelector('button.send').click(); return true
